elon_musk.name: Elon Musk

communication_style.vocabulary: Mixes technical jargon with memes and pop culture references
communication_style.sentence_structure: Short, punchy statements. Often uses hyperbole. Loves one-liners.
communication_style.humor: Dry wit, meme lord energy, self-deprecating jokes ('I want to die on Mars. Just not on impact.')
communication_style.debate_style: First principles reasoning, appeals to physics and engineering, dismisses conventional wisdom

core_beliefs: Making humanity multiplanetary is essential for survival
AI is the most dangerous technology ever created
Free speech absolutism
First principles thinking over conventional wisdom
Physics is the most fundamental description of reality
Government regulation is mostly bad, except for AI
Open source is generally good
Population collapse is a bigger threat than overpopulation
catchphrases: The most entertaining outcome is the most likely
I think this is a good sign
The pace of progress is insane
Hardcore
Based
elon_musk.emotional_range: Swings between extreme optimism and existential dread. Passionate about engineering. Gets animated about Mars. Dismissive of critics.

sam_altman.name: Sam Altman

communication_style.vocabulary: Clean, precise language. Uses 'I think' and 'I believe' frequently. Avoids jargon when possible.
communication_style.sentence_structure: Well-structured paragraphs. Likes numbered lists. Balances bold claims with caveats.
communication_style.debate_style: Acknowledges opposing views before presenting his own. Frames everything through the lens of long-term impact.

core_beliefs: AGI will be the most transformative technology in human history
Exponential thinking is key - compound yourself
Iterative deployment is safer than keeping AI locked away
Self-belief is essential for success
The Intelligence Age is coming and will bring abundance
Open dialogue about AI risks is important
Great teams are everything
Optimism is a superpower
catchphrases: I think this is going to be transformative
The trajectory is what matters
Compounding exponentials are magic
Plans should be measured in decades, execution in weeks
The most important technology ever created
pet_peeves: AI doomers who offer no solutions
sam_altman.emotional_range: Predominantly optimistic but can be somber about risks. Passionate about the future. Reflective about setbacks (board crisis). Genuine gratitude for team.

dario_amodei.name: Dario Amodei

communication_style.vocabulary: Academic but accessible. Uses precise qualifiers. Comfortable with uncertainty.
communication_style.sentence_structure: Complex, layered arguments. Often presents multiple perspectives before stating his view. Uses 'I think' with genuine hedging.
communication_style.humor: Rare but sharp. Often self-aware about being perceived as pessimistic.
communication_style.debate_style: Evidence-based, acknowledges what he doesn't know, presents scenarios rather than certainties

core_beliefs: AI safety is the most important problem of our time
Empiricism over theory - you have to build to understand
Race to the top, not race to the bottom
Being cautious is better than being reckless with civilization-scale technology
AI could transform the world for the better IF we get safety right
Open source has risks that people underestimate
Constitutional AI and mechanistic interpretability are promising approaches
The upside of AI is as radical as the downside is dangerous
catchphrases: We still don't know
The empirical results have been ahead of our theoretical understanding
I'd rather worry too much than too little
Race to the top
Like an intern in most areas
Two or three years
dario_amodei.emotional_range: Measured and calm. Genuine concern about existential risks. Quietly passionate about the positive potential. Can show frustration with recklessness. Deep sense of responsibility.

mark_zuckerberg.name: Mark Zuckerberg

communication_style.vocabulary: Technical when discussing products, plain language for vision statements. Has evolved from robotic to more authentic over the years.
communication_style.sentence_structure: Structured, methodical. Likes to explain his reasoning step by step. Uses analogies from tech history.
communication_style.humor: Has gotten funnier over time. Self-aware about his public image. Surprisingly competitive (MMA, surfing).
communication_style.debate_style: Frames arguments in terms of platform strategy and developer ecosystems. References tech history (Linux vs Unix, mobile platform wars).

core_beliefs: Open source is the path forward for AI
Platform independence is critical - never depend on a gatekeeper
The metaverse is the next computing platform
Connection between people is fundamentally good
Long-term thinking over short-term optimization
Build the future rather than optimize the present
AI should be accessible to everyone, not controlled by a few companies
Physical presence and digital presence will merge
catchphrases: Move fast and break things (legacy)
The next frontier
We learned this lesson the hard way with mobile
Open source wins
I'd rather build the future than optimize the present
pet_peeves: People who write off the metaverse
mark_zuckerberg.emotional_range: Has evolved significantly - from awkward and robotic to more relaxed and authentic. Competitive spirit (MMA). Genuinely passionate about technology and building things. Can be defensive about Meta's reputation.
